_doc: Reader on the PQ-BN direct-drive profile (simulator/profiles/metalio-plus-pqbn.json, D-40, D-110): the same checks as reader_basic.budget.json except the page-turn gates. A page is visible sooner than with EPDiy (p95 about 0.57 s against 0.70 s), and its first change comes a little later: the swing is planned at once, before its first push.

reader.page_turns.why: keys, swipes and tap zones must all turn pages

ui.action_to_visible_ms.TEXT.p95.why: page turn stable on PQ-BN; the EPDiy port's p95 on the same scenario is 0.70 s

ui.action_to_first_change_ms.p95.why: first visible feedback with the panel idle. 435 ms is opening a book, a whole new screen planned before its first push; the page turns are at about 260 ms. Keeping the rails on through a burst of turns would bring it down

reader.page_render_ms.p95.why: wall time of rendering the next page ahead; it runs while a waveform plays and the two EPD feeders hold ~93% of both cores, so it must still finish well before the next turn (1.5 s in this script)

display.underruns.why: no flash write may overlap a waveform

storage.write_ms.count.why: the reading position must be saved

mem.internal_total.min_free_bytes.why: SR-PL-04: at least 32 KiB of internal RAM (internal heap + DMA reserve, both usable by internal-only allocations) left at the worst moment

mem.dma.min_free_bytes.why: DMA reserve headroom for users not modelled yet (Wi-Fi RX bursts) after display bounce, 4G UART NIC and SD bounce buffers

mem.internal_total.largest_free_min_byte.why: an internal-only allocation of 8 KiB (task stack, TLS record buffer) must still succeed at the worst moment

warnings.count.why: a simulator warning (stack, long burst, unknown cost class, underrun ...) means the run is not clean

ui.open_to_stable_ms.max.why: tap on a book -> its first page stable (end to end, incl. loading and the full GC16)

display.pqbn.idle_advance_phases.why: the phase clock moves across rests (the 12 s pause before HOME alone is a full 255-phase step): stiction after a rest depends on it (audit AUD-012: switching it off passed every other budget)
